sections.description:

Ask questions like:
✅ “Show me my top 10 customers this month”
✅ “Which products are selling best by region?”
✅ “How much did I earn last week compared to last month?”
✅ “Which customers haven’t ordered in 3 months?”

Get instant, detailed answers with charts and actionable recommendations.

Why Askeet Changes Everything

🚀 Save 10+ Hours Per Week – No more manual report generation
💡 Make Faster Decisions – Get insights instantly, not in days
📈 Boost Your Revenue – Discover hidden opportunities in your data
🎯 Zero Learning Curve – If you can ask a question, you can use Askeet

Perfect For

  • Marketing managers tracking campaign performance
  • Business owners making data-driven decisions
  • Anyone tired of complex analytics dashboards

Key Features

🎤 Natural Language Interface

🔄 Smart Comparisons

📈 Professional Reporting
* Beautiful, clear charts and graphs
* One-click export (PDF, Excel, CSV)
* Shareable reports for your team
* Custom dashboard creation

🔒 Enterprise Security
* Your data stays on your server
* No sensitive information transmitted
* GDPR compliant
* Secure API communications

Real Results from Real Users

“Before Askeet, I spent 2 hours weekly on reports. Now I get all my answers in 2 minutes!” – E-commerce Store Owner

“Finally, I can understand my data without calling my developer!” – Online Retailer

Customer Insights:

Product Performance:

Business Intelligence:

No configuration needed. No technical setup. Just install and go!

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Askeet”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Start asking questions about your WooCommerce data!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the askeet.zip file
  2. Upload askeet.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Extract the files
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  5. You’re ready to go!

After Installation

  1. Look for the “Askeet” menu item in your WordPress admin
  2. Click to open the interface
  3. Type your first question like “Show me my sales this month”
  4. Watch the magic happen!
sections.faq:
Do I need an account or subscription?

No account needed to start! The free version gives you 50 questions per month. For unlimited usage, upgrade to Pro.

Is my data secure?

Absolutely! Askeet works directly on your website. Your sensitive data never leaves your server. Only anonymized query structures are processed for AI analysis.

Do I need technical skills?

Zero technical skills required! If you can ask a question in normal language, you can use Askeet. It’s designed for business owners, not developers.

Does it work with my theme and other plugins?

Yes! Askeet is compatible with 100% of WooCommerce themes and plugins. It works behind the scenes without affecting your store’s appearance.

What languages are supported?

Askeet supports multiple languages and can understand questions in your native language. The interface adapts to your WordPress language settings.

Can I export the results?

Yes! With the Pro version, you can export all reports and charts to PDF, Excel, or CSV formats for sharing with your team or for further analysis.

What if I’m not satisfied?

We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee. If Askeet doesn’t meet your expectations, get a full refund, no questions asked.

Can I use it for multiple stores?

The Enterprise version supports multiple WooCommerce stores from a single dashboard, perfect for agencies or multi-store owners.

How often is the data updated?

Askeet analyzes real-time data from your WooCommerce database, so you always get the most current information available.

Do you provide support?

Yes! Free version gets community support, Pro users get priority email support, and Enterprise users get dedicated account management.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release
  • Natural language query interface
  • Basic analytics and reporting
  • Free tier with 50 monthly queries
  • WooCommerce integration
  • Multilingual support
  • Export functionality (Pro)

2.0

  • NEW: Modern subscription management page with pricing cards and one-click upgrades
  • NEW: Smart pagination – display 50 rows, export up to 1,500 rows per page
  • IMPROVED: Export limit increased to 10,000 rows with “Export All” button
  • IMPROVED: Dynamic rows per page selector (20, 50, 100, 500, 1,500)
  • IMPROVED: Performance notifications for large datasets
  • FIXED: Upgrade modal display when reaching plan limits
  • UPDATED: Community links (Discord + Slack)
  • UPDATED: UI/UX design optimization with better responsiveness
  • NEW: Add annual payment and date renew

2.5

  • NEW: Star rating system (1-5 stars) for AI responses – Rate response quality with a simple click
  • NEW: Feedback modal with thumbs up/down and optional comments – Share your experience directly from the plugin
  • NEW: Smart auto-retry system – Automatically retries up to 5 times silently before showing error
  • NEW: AI disclaimer notice displayed with error messages to remind users to verify responses
  • NEW: “Send Feedback” button in header for quick access
  • IMPROVED: Modern animated modals for success/error notifications (glassmorphism design)
  • FIXED: Discord, Slack, and Contact button text visibility (white text on gradient background)
  • FIXED: Subscription upgrade now correctly modifies existing subscription instead of creating duplicates
  • IMPROVED: Full internationalization (i18n) support for all new UI elements
  • IMPROVED: Better error handling with user-friendly messages

Upcoming Features

  • Advanced forecasting
  • Automated report scheduling
  • Custom KPI tracking
  • Integration with Google Analytics
  • Advanced segmentation tools
  • API for developers
